brief_title: Oral Administration of STC-15 in Subjects With Advanced Malignancies
specific_indication: Advanced Cancer; Advanced Solid Tumor; Cancer
design_archetype_verbatim: This Phase 1, multi-center, open-label, first-in-human study evaluates multiple ascending daily oral doses of STC-15 in Q3W treatment cycles in a 3+3 cohort design with dose levels determined by a modified Fibonacci algorithm (protocolSection.descriptionModule.briefSummary) | Dose levels for further evaluation in expansion cohorts will be selected based on all available PK, pharmacodynamic, target engagement, efficacy, safety, and tolerability data including long-term safety data beyond dose limiting toxicities (DLTs) (protocolSection.descriptionModule.briefSummary)
